Karnataka Ordinance 4 of 2021.instrument: Karnataka State Civil Services (Regulation of Transfer of Teachers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
Karnataka Ordinance 4 of 2021.summary: The Ordinance came into force at once on 29 April 2021. Its section 2 inserted sub-section (6) after section 10(5) of the 2020 Act. The new provision gave certain teachers transferred in 2019-20 a one-time opportunity to opt for a posting in their earlier taluk or district, subject to available vacancies and the prescribed manner.
